title: Designing Textual Interfaces To Enhance Llm Reasoning On Audio-Visual Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2610.20085v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has shown strong effectiveness for text-based LLMs and LLM systems, but its application to audio-visual understanding systems requires suitable textual interfaces through which multimodal reasoning can be exposed to text-based optimizers. We investigate how the design of textual interfaces affects prompt optimization for multimodal reasoning, on the audio-visual question answering task. We compare three interface designs, including a direct inference system consisting of a single omni-modal large language model (OmniLLM), a captioner-reasoner system, and an agentic architecture in which a primary agent orchestrates subagent OmniLLMs. Experiments with Qwen3-Omni and Gemini show that direct prompt optimization provides model-dependent gains; the captioner-reasoner system and the agentic system expose more interpretable optimization interfaces but are harder to optimize, where error analysis of cases af

translated_title: 设计文本接口以增强大语言模型在视听问答任务上的推理能力
translated_abstract: 自动提示优化（APO）已在基于文本的大语言模型（LLM）及LLM系统中展现出强大的有效性，但将其应用于视听理解系统需要合适的文本接口，以便通过这些接口将多模态推理呈现给基于文本的优化器。我们以视听问答任务为研究对象，探讨了文本接口的设计如何影响多模态推理的提示优化。我们比较了三种接口设计，包括由单个全模态大语言模型（OmniLLM）构成的直接推理系统、描述器-推理器系统，以及一种由主智能体协调多个子智能体OmniLLM的智能体架构。基于Qwen3-Omni和Gemini的实验表明，直接提示优化带来的收益依赖于具体模型；描述器-推理器系统和智能体系统暴露出更具可解释性的优化接口，但更难进行优化，对相关案例的错误分析显示……
tldr: 本研究探讨了文本接口设计对多模态推理系统中自动提示优化的影响，发现全模态LLM直接优化收益依赖具体模型，而描述器-推理器和智能体架构虽提供更可解释的优化接口却更难优化。
en_tdlr: This study investigates how textual interface design affects automatic prompt optimization for multimodal reasoning in audio-visual question answering, showing that direct optimization of OmniLLMs yields model-dependent gains, while captioner-reasoner and agentic architectures offer more interpretable optimization interfaces but are harder to optimize.
